Once you register, you can vote in national, state, and local elections.

### Voting as a new U.S. citizen Find out what you need to know about voting and participating in American elections.### Voting as a military service member Learn how you and your family can register and vote from anywhere you’re stationed.### Voting from outside of the U.S. You can vote by mail from anywhere in the world.### Voting with a disability Know your rights and voting accommodations protected by law.### Voting while unhoused You don’t need a home address to register and vote.### Voting after a felony conviction Your eligibility to vote after a conviction can be different from state to state.### Preparing to vote: age 18 and under Take steps now so you are ready to vote when you turn 18.
